name: Amazon A+ Content Creator (KDP)
tagline: Plans and renders Amazon A+ modules for self-published books, claims kept honest
description: A polish studio for the product pages behind self-published books. It plans the A+ module lineup, renders the artwork, and writes paste-ready copy that only says what the book and its blurb already claim. Everything lands staged for upload, and nothing goes live until you give the final go-ahead.
author: El_Tonio83
